relevance.rationale: Adjacent to conj:qou-infra-discharges-goncharov-zeta5, which invokes Borel's theorem for K_5^ind(Q(zeta_5)) tensor Q of rank 2 and the Goncharov regulator on the weight-3 Bloch group -- so this paper's subject (regulators for higher K-groups of number fields versus special values of L-functions) is the right neighbourhood, and Q(zeta_5) is abelian over Q, which is precisely the case they prove. But their content is the P-ADIC analogue: syntomic regulators and p-adic L-functions, a conjecture the folio makes no claim about anywhere. What QOU needs is the ARCHIMEDEAN Borel regulator, which this paper only recalls in its introduction as motivation and does not extend. I read the introduction and conjecture statements looking for a transferable result and did not find one. Scope-(a) negative: this document, as read, supplies nothing the folio can consume -- not a claim that p-adic regulator methods are excluded from the Goncharov-zeta5 program.

proposedActions.rationale: Read and judged. No block wants a result from it; the only overlap is background that conj:qou-infra-discharges-goncharov-zeta5 already carries (Borel's theorem, Bloch groups, regulators), and registering a p-adic reference with no citation site would just add an uncited bib entry.
proposedActions.target: conj:qou-infra-discharges-goncharov-zeta5 (considered and declined as a citation site)
